name: WasteKart player amulets

geometry_unchanged.note: visible medallion has exactly radius 39 (6 px colour rim = r 33..39); soft drop shadow (offset +3 px down) is baked in and reaches r 43

placement.blit_top_left: (cx - 48, cy - 48) where (cx, cy) is the PLAYER_AMULETS entry
placement.badge_top_left: (cx - 27 - 16, cy - 27 - 16)  [badge sprite is 32x32, centred on the old badge point]

files.amulets/amulet_<i>_<name>_socket.png: rim in PALETTE[i] colour + dark glass dish with a recessed pocket (radius 21, centred at (cx, cy-4)) for the existing TURBO / TAILWIND / ? logos (drawn by draw_powerup_icon at (cx, cy-4), size 34)
files.amulets/amulet_<i>_<name>_plain.png: same without the pocket: use for KART / selection / PICK / reflex TAP, EARLY, BOOST text states
files.amulets/amulet_off_socket.png / amulet_o: grey disabled corner (player not in the game); the em dash is still drawn by code
files.badges/badge_<i>_<name>_p<1-4>.png: number badge, colour of the kart, number baked (dark ink)
files.badges/badge_<i>_<name>_blank.png: badge without number if you prefer self.text()
files.fx/halo_gold.png: gold ready / active-selection glow ring, replaces the pygame circle(YELLOW); pulse with alpha 0.55..1.0 or scale 1.0..1.06 around the centre
files.fx/halo_turbo.png, fx/halo_tailwind.png: same ring in the two boost colours, for the running-boost state
files.fx/pressed_overlay.png: draw on top of the amulet (under the logo) for ~0.12 s on tap

draw_order_per_corner: amulet sprite (it already contains the shadow)
existing logo via draw_powerup_icon (cx, cy-4, 34) or the kart image / text
boost timer arc (pygame.draw.arc, radius 32 fits inside the rim)
notes: The pocket sits at (cx, cy-4); the old kart image (39x29 at cy-3) also fits inside the dish when you use the plain variant.
Pre-load all sprites once; the 4 corners only need the 8 colours x 2 variants plus 1 off sprite.
